releases.name: Kingdom Hearts III + Re Mind
releases.summary:
The other tale that unfolded during the climax of KINGDOM HEARTS III.

Determined to rescue Kairi, Sora travels to the Keyblade Graveyard a short time before the final battle was to take place. Lacking a corporeal form, he traces the hearts of the seven guardians of light. Through experiencing their personal battles firsthand, Sora is about to discover truths that he has never before imagined.

The KINGDOM HEARTS III Re Mind DLC includes:

The additional story: Re Mind
Limitcut episode and 13 boss battles
Secret episode and boss battle
Data greeting feature
Slideshow feature
Premium menu (Diverse difficulty settings and gameplay challenges)

releases.name: Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
releases.summary:
Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue is a compilation that brings the popular Kingdom Hearts: Dream Drop Distance to the PlayStation 4 computer entertainment system platform remastered in high definition.

Originally released in 2012, Kingdom Hearts: Dream Drop Distance HD is a full-HD remastered version of Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance. Series protagonists Sora and Riku take on the Mark of Mastery exam in preparation for coming threats. The signature action of the Kingdom Hearts series has evolved, allowing players to experience faster-paced battles and exploration at a blistering pace. 

This newly remastered title also features Kingdom Hearts 0.2: Birth by Sleep - A Fragmentary Passage - a completely new playable episode that links to the story of Kingdom Hearts III, taking place after the storyline of Kingdom Hearts: Birth by Sleep played from the perspective of Aqua.

releases.name: Kingdom Hearts Collection I ~ III
releases.summary: A value‑packed bundle featuring three collections: KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-, KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue, and KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC).

releases.name: Kingdom Hearts HD I.5 + II.5 Remix
releases.summary:
KINGDOM HEARTS HD 1.5 + 2.5 ReMIX is the essential HD remastered collection, featuring:

* KINGDOM HEARTS FINAL MIX
* KINGDOM HEARTS Re:Chain of Memories
* KINGDOM HEARTS 358/2 Days (HD Remastered cinematics)
* KINGDOM HEARTS II FINAL MIX
* KINGDOM HEARTS Birth by Sleep Final MIX
* KINGDOM HEARTS Re:coded (HD Remastered cinematics)

This is is the perfect opportunity to start wielding your Keyblade to save the Disney worlds from darkness!

releases.name: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
releases.summary:
Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a runs-based, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim of the Star Wars galaxy.  

The Empire’s grip on the galaxy has finally broken, and with its fall comes a new obsession: speed. As the New Republic struggles to rebuild, gambling, entertainment, and glory fuel a booming underground.  

Out of this chaos, The Galactic League is born: an unsanctioned racing circuit where syndicates sponsor pilots, fortunes are won and lost in seconds, and only the bold survive. 

No Force. No prophecy. Just skill, strategy, and the will to rise.

releases.name: Legendary Tales: Stories
releases.summary:
Discover what lies behind the scenes of the stories from the world of Legendary Tales! Here, you'll discover how an ordinary herbalist handled a deadly disease spreading across his village, how a young girl navigated a dangerous forest to deliver gifts to her ailing grandmother, and even follow a brave warrior in search of his friend's children! 

Follow the clues as events unfold while searching for hidden objects, gathering unique collectibles, and solving challenging puzzles! Gather your courage for an epic tale of legend!

releases.name: Banker Simulator
releases.summary: Banker Simulator is a single-player game where you revive a bankrupt bank. With active and passive (idle) gameplay, make strategic decisions to grow your bank, satisfy customers, and tackle financial crises.

releases.name: Easy Fishing Simulator
releases.summary: Easy Fishing Simulator invites you to unwind by the water with the most accessible fishing experience yet.Cast your line, wait for a bite, and reel in your catch - every step is designed to feel intuitive and rewarding, whether you're a fishing veteran or picking up a rod for the first time.Simple, satisfying gameplay:Cast, hook, and fight fish with easy-to-learn controls. Feel the tension on your line as you reel in everything from tiny minnows to trophy-sized catches.Living waters:Fish behave naturally - swimming, exploring, and reacting to your bait. Every species has its own personality, from cautious bottom feeders to aggressive predators chasing your lure.Progress at your own pace:Sell your catch, earn money, and upgrade your gear to reach new fishing spots and land bigger fish. Keep your favorites or release them back into the water - the choice is yours.Relaxing by designNo pressure, no timers, no stress. Just you, the water, and the next big catch.Grab your rod and cast your first line today.Key features- Easy-to-learn fishing controls, perfect for all ages- Realistic fish behavior and multiple species to discover- Catch, sell, and upgrade your equipment- Relaxing, low-pressure gameplay- Save your progress and keep building your collection

releases.name: HAMVENTURE
releases.summary:
Hamventure is a platformer featuring creative puzzles and engaging challenges. Guide a small pig through 40 levels, overcoming traps such as spikes, saws, and arrows that react to your movements.
Each level introduces new situations that will make you think before taking your first jump.

releases.name: Mister Scary - Where Are You?
releases.summary: Help Mister Scary find his missing family in a spooky retro platforming adventure filled with monsters, bosses, secrets, and Halloween fun!

releases.name: Blocky Powers
releases.summary:
BLOCKY POWERS is a block-stacking game that combines realistic physics with 2-player local multiplayer. Build the tallest and most stable tower with your friends and enjoy an exciting competition! 

You can't win just by stacking blocks. Every block is affected by weight and balance and will sway. Furthermore, strong winds will hit your tower, and even a small mistake will lead to collapse.

releases.name: Top Down Rally Racing
releases.summary: Speed across sun-soaked island resorts in this fast-paced top-down rally racer. Tear through coastal roads, palm-lined circuits, and resort backstreets as you climb the ranks to become the ultimate rally champion.Features:- Island Resort Circuits – Race through vibrant tropical courses inspired by beautiful island resorts- Full Car Roster – Choose your ride from a selection of unique vehicles- 1-2 Player Local Multiplayer – Race solo or go head-to-head with a friend on the same screen- 3 Game Modes – Compete in multiple ways to prove your skill- Garage Customization – Personalize your car to match your style- Podium Finishes – Battle for the top spot after every race- Local Leaderboard – Chase the best times and challenge your friends- Save System – Jump back in anytime, right where you left off- French & English Language SupportGrab the wheel, hit the coast, and race your way to victory in the most scenic rally on the island!

releases.name: Hotel Simulator
releases.summary: Build and manage your own hotel, from a small property to a luxury resort. Design rooms, maintain cleanliness, develop amenities, and offer guests unforgettable experiences at your hotel! Furnish and Decorate RoomsCreate unique rooms that meet every guest's expectations. Choose from a wide range of furniture, decorations, and styles - from modern to classic and themed. Your creativity will determine the hotel's unique character and high guest ratings.Run a Mini Guest ShopExpand your services by creating a shop with snacks, souvenirs, and everyday items. Manage inventory, set prices, and maintain order so guests feel comfortable and eager to take advantage of additional offers.Cleanliness and Comfort at the Highest LevelRegular cleaning of rooms and common areas is key to guest satisfaction. Maintain cleanliness and stock up on essential supplies to make guests feel at home – this is the foundation of good reviews and repeat bookings.Hotel Expansion and PrestigeInvest in improvements and expand your hotel by adding new rooms, attractive amenities like a spa or gym, and unique features. Increase your reputation and revenue by creating the perfect place for your dream vacation.

releases.name: Rooms
releases.summary: Rooms is an atmospheric first-person horror game in which an abandoned, dilapidated house becomes a puzzle in its own right. Search dark rooms, examine mysterious objects and solve mechanical and logical challenges to uncover the way to the final exit. Every door you open leads deeper into an interconnected labyrinth of clues, keys and hidden dangers.But you are not alone. The Gazer forces you to look darkness straight in the face, the Linger makes even safe hiding places more dangerous with every passing second, and the Harrow announces its deadly hunt with flickering lights and a rapidly approaching rumble. To survive, you must listen, understand the warning signs and act at the right moment.In Puzzle Mode, you enter different rooms and must solve the puzzles within them to progress. In Endless Mode, the house rearranges itself for every attempt: 100 rooms, wrong turns, stairs, brief interruptions involving keys and power, and an invisible presence that punishes slow progress. The timer runs until the final door, and your personal best time is saved.

releases.name: Monster Nursery
releases.summary: A relaxing idle monster collection game (with offline progress). Features 200 monster entries and 29 Lo-fi tracks.

releases.name: Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War
releases.summary: Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War thrusts players back in time, 15 years before the events of "Ace Combat 5," and reveals the events that led up to the last chapter of the franchise. Players will take on the role of a mercenary hired to fly for Ustio, a small country bordering Belka, and face off against rival pilots throughout the game. Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War introduces rival pilots to the series' traditional dogfighting action. Players will encounter highly skilled enemy pilots that they will engage throughout the course of the story. Adding even more tension to the game's dramatic air battles, these rival pilots utilize advanced battle tactics to attack the player while directing their own squadron. [Namco]

releases.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
releases.summary:
Step into the cockpit and take flight as an elite pilot across stunning skies. Enter intense dogfights, eliminate threats, and rise through gripping missions to earn your wings.

Campaign Mode showcases stunning visuals with dynamic multi-layered cloudscapes that capture the majesty of living skies. Feel the rush of a fast-paced arcade-style gameplay and deploy powerful weapons to dominate the battlefield.

Beyond the chaos in the air, breathtaking first-person scenes reveal your pilot’s story through breathtaking cinematics. Experience the pressure of command, the weight of decisions, and the bonds forged in battle. Between missions, bond with your squad members, rise to meet adversity, and prove yourself as a true ace.

releases.name: Seek
releases.summary:
In this unique survival horror game, classical music intertwines with psychological terror to create an oppressive, chilling atmosphere. You play Alice, an ordinary girl who wakes up to find herself trapped in a bizarre, ever-changing world. A snowbound orphanage, monsters lurking in the shadows, and intricate puzzles—every step is fraught with danger and uncertainty.

To survive, you must gather supplies, evade pursuit, and uncover the secrets hidden in the darkness. But as the truth gradually comes to light, can you bear the cruel reality behind it all?

Gameplay features:
Action Shooting
Use a variety of firearms to defeat enemies

Map Exploration
Explore the eerie orphanage step by step, collecting items to unlock new areas while confronting unexplained changes that may occur without warning

Resource Management
Gather and make prudent use of limited resources, and do whatever it takes to survive

Puzzle Solving
Gather clues, solve a wide range of puzzles, and uncover the final truth

releases.name: TOYCRAFTER
releases.summary:
You were once a dedicated toycrafter, spending hours working alone in your workshop. But recently you lost your passion for your trade. 

Working on small toys no longer satisfies you. You shifted your focus towards something more grand, more robust.

Cut, paint and attach doll parts to build unique and unsettling sculptures. Ignore any anomalies you see or hear.

releases.name: Chack'n Pop
releases.summary: Chack 'N Pop was released by Taito in 1983. A platform game in which a round yellow creature uses bombs to release the encaged hearts taken from him and his love, so he can go to the next level.

releases.name: Balloon Bomber
releases.summary:
"BALLOON BOMBER" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1980.
Control the anti-aircraft gun and destroy the balloon bombs as they gently sway through the air.
However, destroying the balloon bombs is no easy task. Aim and shoot so your bullets hit only the bomb itself.
If your shot hits the balloon instead, the bomb will fall and blow a hole in the ground. Be careful, as the anti-aircraft gun cannot pass over holes, narrowing your movement range.

releases.name: Crazy Balloon (1980)
releases.summary: Guide a swaying balloon through a thorny maze and attempt to reach the goal while avoiding traps such as moving thorns, scrolling mazes and more.

releases.name: Moros Protocol
releases.summary: Face the darkness in Moros Protocol, a pixel-painted sci-fi FPS roguelite where every battle is for survival. Stranded on a decaying warship, stalked by horrors, and guided by a voice you don't recognize, you must adapt, upgrade and push forward. You may be outnumbered, but you are not outmatched.

releases.name: Retrospace
releases.summary: Immersive, disco-punk, space horror where you can be a sneaky chap or a mutant action hero as you try to survive on a space station swallowed by a black hole. A mind-bending ride with weird creatures, immersive features, time jumps, and '70s mustaches!
